## Analysis overview

Selects analysis-ready ADAS-Cog total records, summarizes baseline, Week 8, and change from baseline, and fits the efficacy comparison model.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSADAS`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAMCD`: parameter code, restricted to ACTOT
- `AVAL`: analysis value
- `BASE`: baseline value
- `CHG`: change from baseline
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit number
- `EFFFL/ITTFL/ANL01FL`: analysis selection flags
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
